result.stdout:
Apply stretch, corner-pin (video/sticker), or surface-track deformation.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
          --ref TEXT          Unified draft reference
          --mode TEXT:{stretch,scale,corner-pin,corner_pin,perspective,surface-track,surface_track,surface,plane-track} REQUIRED 
                              Deform mode: stretch, corner-pin, or surface-track
          --deform-seg-id TEXT 
                              Edited segment id for stretch/corner-pin modes
          --follower-seg-id TEXT 
                              Follower segment id for surface-track mode
          --tracked-video-seg-id TEXT 
                              Tracked source video segment id for surface-track mode
          --corner-top-left TEXT 
                              Corner-pin top-left point x,y
          --corner-bottom-left TEXT 
                              Corner-pin bottom-left point x,y
          --corner-top-right TEXT 
                              Corner-pin top-right point x,y
          --corner-bottom-right TEXT 
                              Corner-pin bottom-right point x,y
          --plane-top-left TEXT 
                              Surface-track initial plane top-left point x,y
          --plane-bottom-left TEXT 
                              Surface-track initial plane bottom-left point x,y
          --plane-top-right TEXT 
                              Surface-track initial plane top-right point x,y
          --plane-bottom-right TEXT 
                              Surface-track initial plane bottom-right point x,y
          --content-u-min TEXT 
                              Follower left edge in tracked-plane coordinates for surface-track
                              mode
          --content-u-max TEXT 
                              Follower right edge in tracked-plane coordinates for
                              surface-track mode
          --content-v-min TEXT 
                              Follower top edge in tracked-plane coordinates for surface-track
                              mode
          --content-v-max TEXT 
                              Follower bottom edge in tracked-plane coordinates for
                              surface-track mode
          --tracking-begin-time <duration> 
                              Surface-track begin time; explicit unit required: us, ms, s, or
                              min
          --tracking-end-time <duration> 
                              Surface-track end time; explicit unit required: us, ms, s, or min
          --tracking-seed-time <duration> 
                              Surface-track seed-frame time; explicit unit required: us, ms, s,
                              or min
          --scale TEXT        Uniform stretch/scale value
          --scale-x TEXT      Horizontal stretch/scale value
          --scale-y TEXT      Vertical stretch/scale value
          --position-x TEXT   Optional canvas x position update
          --position-y TEXT   Optional canvas y position update
          --rotation TEXT     Optional rotation update in degrees
          --alpha TEXT        Optional alpha update
          --wait-for-tracking Wait for surface-track algorithm completion
          --no-wait-for-tracking 
                              Do not wait for surface-track algorithm completion
          --tracking-timeout <duration> 
                              Caller-side surface-track wait timeout; explicit unit required
          --tracking-poll-interval <duration> [1s] 
                              Surface-track task status poll interval; explicit unit required
          --enable-scale-tracking 
                              Enable scale tracking in surface-track mode
          --enable-relative-distance-tracking 
                              Enable relative-distance tracking in surface-track mode
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

EXAMPLES
  $ lyra-cli draft deform apply --mode stretch --deform-seg-id <id> --scale-x 1.2 --scale-y 1.5
  $ lyra-cli draft deform apply --mode corner-pin --deform-seg-id <id> --corner-top-left "-0.2,0.2" --corner-bottom-left "-0.2,-0.2" --corner-top-right "0.2,0.2" --corner-bottom-right "0.2,-0.2"
  $ lyra-cli draft deform apply --mode surface-track --tracked-video-seg-id <video> --follower-seg-id <follower> --plane-top-left "-0.2,0.2" --plane-bottom-left "-0.2,-0.2" --plane-top-right "0.2,0.2" --plane-bottom-right "0.2,-0.2" --content-u-min 0.05 --content-u-max 0.95 --content-v-min 0.36 --content-v-max 0.52 --tracking-begin-time 3s --tracking-end-time 5.2s --tracking-seed-time 3s --no-wait-for-tracking
  $ lyra-cli draft algo query --task-id <task_id>
